hero.caption: Front of the Fred M. Vinson Birthplace, located on the northwestern corner of the junction of Madison Street (Kentucky Route 3) and Vinson Avenue in Louisa, Kentucky, United States.  Built in 1889 and the childhood home of Fred M. Vinson, Chief Justice of the United States, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
